components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action per view; teal→azure gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #35d0a5, #4aa3ff); color: #06231c; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.08s, filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action on a raised navy surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #222c3c; color: #eaf0f7; border: 1px solid #2b3648; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.08s; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Field on raised navy; focus shifts the border to teal, no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #222c3c; border: 1px solid #2b3648; color: #eaf0f7; border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px 12px; font-size: 15px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9aa7b8; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #35d0a5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default content surface: panel navy, hairline border, ambient lift.
components.html:
מחשבון BMI
הזינו גיל, משקל וגובה כדי לחשב.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1b2230; border: 1px solid #2b3648; border-radius: 18px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); color: #eaf0f7; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; color: #9aa7b8; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill metadata tag; muted by default, semantic tints recolor text only.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; background: #222c3c; border: 1px solid #2b3648; color: #9aa7b8; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar
components.description: Fixed bottom navigation; active tab gets teal text on a teal tint.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: #1b2230; border: 1px solid #2b3648; border-radius: 16px; padding: 6px 8px; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: none; border: none; color: #9aa7b8; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 7px 4px; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-tab .ds-ti { font-size: 21px; line-height: 1; } .ds-tab.on { color: #35d0a5; background: color-mix(in srgb, #35d0a5 12%, transparent); } .ds-tab:active { transform: scale(0.94); }

components.name: Calendar Cell
components.description: Signature square day cell; today wears an inset teal ring, status shown by a dot.
components.css: .ds-cell { position: relative; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 12px; background: #222c3c; border: 1px solid transparent; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; cursor: pointer; color: #eaf0f7; } .ds-cell.today { border-color: #35d0a5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #35d0a5 inset; } .ds-cell.today .ds-dnum { color: #35d0a5; } .ds-dnum { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #35d0a5; }

narrative.overview: Excerly is a personal health console you can read in a glance. It is dark by default, built as a single thumb-width column, and it earns trust through precision rather than personality: numbers are legible, states are unambiguous, and color is spent carefully. Every screen is a surface for a task, so the interface stays quiet and lets the data speak. The palette is a cool, dark neutral base carrying one primary voice — Signal Teal — with Azure and Amber reserved for information and attention. Content surfaces sit flat on tonal layers; only true overlays and the single primary action lift off the page.
keyCharacteristics: One saturated accent (Signal Teal) carries the primary/interactive meaning.
Tabular, high-weight numerals for every metric.
Flat at rest, lifted only for overlays and the primary CTA.
Motion is functional feedback and always respects prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Teal is rationed to 10% or less of any screen — ideally a single element: the one primary action, the active tab, or the metric that matters most. Everything secondary defaults to Cloud White or Muted Steel; reach for Azure only for genuinely informational emphasis and Amber only for rest/gym or warnings, both sparingly. Coral is destruction only. The target is a calm, near-monochrome screen with one teal focal point; two saturated accents competing for the eye is the failure.

rules.name: The Constant Figure Rule
rules.body: Exercise figures use Figure Silver and a fixed work highlight in both themes; illustration color does not follow the UI theme.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: Every number a user reads or compares uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits don't jitter as they change.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with weight and color before reaching for larger sizes; the scale is tight on purpose.

rules.name: The Single Column Rule
rules.body: One 620px column with a thumb-reachable bottom nav; do not introduce multi-column desktop layouts or side navigation.

rules.name: The Flat-Rest, Lifted-Overlay Rule
rules.body: Rely first on tonal layers and 1px borders; reserve pronounced elevation and backdrop-filter for true overlays and the single primary CTA. Show state with an inset teal ring, never a colored drop shadow.

dos: Do design to tokens so both themes and RTL/LTR track automatically.
Do ration Signal Teal to 10% or less of a screen — ideally one element — and default secondary content to Cloud White / Muted Steel before reaching for Azure or Amber.
Do give every changing number tabular-nums and an 800 weight.
Do use logical properties for anything positional.
Do reserve real shadows and backdrop-filter for overlays and the single primary CTA.
Do pair every animation with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback and give taps a scale press.
Do keep exercise illustrations on Figure Silver plus the fixed work-highlight in both themes.
donts: Don't spend a second saturated accent where one teal would do, or use Coral for anything but destructive actions.
Don't add desktop multi-column or sidebar layouts; stay in the 620px column with bottom nav.
Don't introduce web fonts or a display typeface — hierarchy comes from weight, color, and number treatment.
Don't show state with a colored drop shadow; use the inset teal ring.
Don't hard-code hex values, physical left/right, or fixed pixel colors that break the light theme or RTL.
Don't let decoration outrank legibility — this is a dashboard, not a poster.
